_judge.note: 16 tank pictures are owner-KEPT (E3): a verdict here does not decide whether they get replaced; they go to him. General remark, not a verdict: the added tubes in every look are smoother and cleaner than the painterly bodies they join (B4 lesson only); at 64 px/cell this does not show.

cmp_Scrapper_RM_LiquidTank.png.note: 4 N/S copper stalks with brass mouths and dark collars sit flush on the body top and under the skid; kept body unchanged. The N stalks are long risers, but they read.

cmp_Scrapper_RM_LiquidTankTall.png.note: W/E stubs collar onto the body side and the skid, S stubs hang under the skid; copper/brass matches the kept brass; no drift.

cmp_Scrapper_RM_UniversalCargoTank.png.note: Upper W/E stubs float over the dome shoulders, anchored only to the strap tops; the E stub covers the kept brass hose outlet at upper right. N+W/E form a crowded T-cluster at each strap. Lower and S ports are fine.

cmp_Scrapper_RM_UniversalCargoTankXTall..note: W/E stubs at mid-body and skid, short S stubs under the skid; attached and legible; body unchanged.

cmp_Industrial_RM_LiquidTank.png.note: Steel N/S stalks with dark collars at the body top and under the skid; the steel tone fits, but it is bluer and cleaner than the grimy body.

cmp_Industrial_RM_LiquidTankTall.png.note: W/E stubs collared to the body and skid, S stubs under the skid; reads as couplers at game scale; no drift.

cmp_Industrial_RM_UniversalCargoTank.png.note: Same layout defect as Scrapper: upper W/E stubs hover over the dome shoulders on the strap tops, and the E stub covers the kept brass outlet fitting.

cmp_Industrial_RM_UniversalCargoTankXTal.note: W/E and S couplers attached to the body and skid; clean; the hazard-band body is unchanged.

cmp_Futuristic_RM_LiquidTank.png.note: The NE stalk's collar sits on the kept elbow-pipe/valve fixture above the body line (it is not on the body) and clips the valve wheel's left edge. The NW, S and body are fine. The stalks' blotchy silver texture is rougher than the glossy body.

cmp_Futuristic_RM_LiquidTankTall.png.note: Silver W/E stubs with dark collars on the body and base, S stubs under the base, cyan rims at the mouths; attached; no drift.

cmp_Futuristic_RM_UniversalCargoTank.png.note: Upper W/E stubs float over the dome shoulders on the strap tops; the E stub covers the kept cyan outlet nozzle at upper right.

cmp_Futuristic_RM_UniversalCargoTankXTal.note: W/E stubs on the body and base, S stubs under the base; matches the silver/cyan trim; body unchanged.

cmp_Modern_RM_LiquidTank.png.note: Dark-grey PVC-style N/S stalks with silver rims match the black cap and grey fittings; collared to the body top and the underside.

cmp_Modern_RM_LiquidTankTall.png.note: The kept W/E fittings are unchanged. The new S stubs cap onto the lower dome and read as couplers, though their flat tops look slightly leg-like.

cmp_Modern_RM_UniversalCargoTank.png.note: The kept W/E fittings are unchanged; short S couplers under the pallet match them exactly.

cmp_Modern_RM_UniversalCargoTankXTall.pn.note: The kept W/E fittings are unchanged; the S couplers cap onto the body bottom in the same material as the W/E fittings.

cmp_RM_PumpingStation_Kludged.png.note: A single S coupler hangs from the pipe support block: a dark collar and a rust-brown ring that match the kludged palette; visible at game scale; no drift.

cmp_RM_PumpingStation_Repaired.png.note: A single S coupler under the wooden skid, with steel/cream rings that echo the cream pipework; attached and legible; no drift.
